relevance_note: Family report of LAMP2 variant carriers: "two male patients, hemizygous for a novel splice-affecting variant c.928+3A>G" plus two heterozygous carrier mothers.
method_note: Built by a short Python script from my own reading; no table was transcribed by script. Four in-scope people: Patient 1 (II-3), Patient 2 (III-1) and the two heterozygous carrier mothers, labelled by their pedigree labels I-2 (mother of Patient 1) and II-2 (mother of Patient 2). Patients labelled 'Patient 1'/'Patient 2', the form used most often. is_proband left null for the patients: the Figure 1 legend says index patients are marked with arrows but the text does not name them. The pedigree relation between II-2 and I-2 is not stated in text, so II-2's own inheritance is 'not reported'. Inheritance 'inherited maternal' for both patients rests on 'DNA samples from both mothers were tested ... heterozygous carriers'. Pathogenicity 'pathogenic' and PS3 are the authors' own proposal for this exact variant (initially VUS, VarSome likely pathogenic; ClinVar conflicting) and are applied to all four carriers; functional (RNA) evidence only to the two patients, because no carrier RNA was obtained. Patient 1 CK '175–297 U/L (Ref < 190 U/L)' described as 'at the upper limit of the reference range': checklist elevated CK left not reported. 'elevated liver enzymes, low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C)' is ambiguous whether 'elevated' applies to LDL-C, so no LDL-C row. Patient 1 retinal changes (cystic macular, tigroid periphery) not mapped to checklist pigmentary retinopathy (not named as such). Patient 2 HCM not mapped to checklist LVH (left ventricle not named); II-2 'thickened cardiac wall' likewise. LVOTO and pulmonary hypertension for Patient 1 recorded excluded from 'no conclusive evidence of'. Patient 2: unremarkable early motor development vs 'psychomotor development was delayed' is a possible tension; checklist developmental delay set observed from psychomotor and language delay. Mothers: 'None of the mothers has a clinically diagnosed intellectual disorder' recorded as an excluded feature (group statement) but checklist cognitive item left not reported because Table 1 gives N/A and no formal testing. Table 1 'None' cells (retinal, myopathic) are words, not symbols. No supplementary text available.
